title: COUNT Bounds RRULE Candidate Generation Prior to EXDATE Exclusion

citations.verbatim_quote: The COUNT rule part defines the number of occurrences at which to range-bound the recurrence. The "DTSTART" property value always counts as the first occurrence.

The final recurrence set is generated by gathering all of the start DATE-TIME values generated by any of the specified "RRULE" and "RDATE" properties, and then excluding any start DATE-TIME values specified by "EXDATE" properties.

The initial date-time to which the rule is applied (the "start" date-time for events or the "start" or "due" date-time for tasks) is always the first occurrence in the expansion (and is counted if the recurrence is limited by a "count" property), even if it would normally not match the rule.

rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.3.10 defines COUNT as a rule part of the RECUR value type (RRULE) that limits the number of occurrences generated by the recurrence rule, with DTSTART always counting as the first occurrence. RFC 5545 Section 3.8.5.1 specifies that the final recurrence set is computed by first gathering all occurrences generated by RRULE (and RDATE) and then excluding occurrences matching EXDATE. Therefore, COUNT bounds candidate generation inside RRULE before EXDATE exclusions are removed; excluding an instance via EXDATE does not cause RRULE to generate an extra replacement instance at the end.
store_implication: When a calendar store deletes a single instance of a recurring series bounded by COUNT=N, the store MUST append the excluded date/time to the master component's EXDATE set and leave the master RRULE's COUNT equal to N. The expanded timeline MUST yield N - |EXDATE intersect RRULE| instances from the RRULE (plus any non-excluded RDATE or override instances), never extending past the Nth candidate generated by RRULE.
edge_cases_and_counterexamples: A daily event starting 2025-05-01 with COUNT=3 generates candidates {May 1, May 2, May 3}. Deleting May 2 as a single instance adds EXDATE=2025-05-02; the timeline yields {May 1, May 3} (2 instances) and MUST NOT extend to May 4.
Deleting the first instance May 1 (DTSTART) as a single instance adds EXDATE=2025-05-01; May 1 still counts as the 1st of the 3 RRULE candidates, so the timeline yields {May 2, May 3}.
Adding an RDATE outside the RRULE's COUNT=N candidate set adds an extra occurrence via set union without reducing the N candidates generated by RRULE.

scenarios.name: count_bounded_before_exdate_on_single_delete
scenarios.description: Deleting the second instance of a COUNT=3 weekly series adds an EXDATE without incrementing COUNT, leaving 2 instances on the timeline.
